overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused and highly engaged professional cross-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content centers primarily on computational social science, disinformation research, software tools like CooRnet, and academic opportunities, yielding high engagement rates across all audiences.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of newly published papers, grants, and academic findings regarding coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on computational software tools like CooRnet v2.0 and discussions on methodological approaches.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD student opportunities in computational social science.
Publicizing upcoming conference presentations and speaking engagements such as DisinfoConf2025.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to leverage its large audience base for higher absolute interaction counts.
Cross-post successful calls for research opportunities across all platforms rather than isolating recruitment posts to single platforms.
Utilize multimedia content or links directly within posts to further boost shareability and engagement metrics.

platformInsights.bluesky: Demonstrates the highest engagement rate (~6.14%), particularly for paper publications and repost-heavy student opportunity announcements.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides strong technical and methodological engagement around tool releases like CooRnet v2.0 from a dedicated niche network.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the largest absolute engagement per post (up to 107 interactions) and is optimal for major announcements like research grants and hiring.
